messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: reserved-pool saturation detected
incident-bot: pool=dedicated-resv-eu-west, reserved_utilization=100%, queue_depth=842, affected_tenants=[NimbusCorp, VeloxHealth], severity=high :rotating_light:
oncall-pager: paging seana (oncall) and jamal (secondary)
seana: ack — I'm up, joining. reading telemetry now.
jamal: ack — on my way. any customer-facing 5xxs?
priya: heads-up from support: NimbusCorp is reporting high latency and some requests timing out in their product. they opened a bridge.
marta: looks like autoscaler isn't spawning new reserved nodes — hitting per-pool scale_limit=12. current_nodes=12.
seana: confirmed. autoscaler logs show `scale_loop: rejected_request reason=scale_limit_reached` for 00:32:10 -> 00:45:22
seana: queue growth pattern: 00:15 -> 00:45 qps up 6x for NimbusCorp, tail latency spike at 95th pct to 4200ms
jamal: suspect noisy neighbor — one tenant has many long-running sessions with large seq_len. pulling top sessions now.
ops-bot: top_sessions dump attached: tenant_id=nv-93, user_sessions=178, avg_seq_len=2048, avg_tokens_per_min=5.6
priya: NimbusCorp tenant id=nv-93 — that matches the noisy tenant.
seana: immediate mitigation options: 1) evict longest idle sessions in nv-93 2) apply provisional weight to throttle nv-93 3) fallback NimbusCorp to hosted pool (if they allow)
jamal: evicting sessions is quickest. can we target sessions >30m active?
marta: we have eviction script but it needs one-time approval for reserved pools. pinging eng-runtime for fast approval.
seana: @marta please run: ```./scripts/evict_sessions --pool dedicated-resv-eu-west --tenant nv-93 --min-active 1800```
marta: running in dry-run first, posting results...
marta: dry-run: would evict 112 sessions, expected free_gpus=3, expected queue_drop=~220
seana: go for it (seana approves). jamal please monitor customer impact and raise rollback if needed.
jamal: eviction in progress. logs: 
```
[00:48:05] evict: session sid=ab12... tenant=nv-93 duration=3850s
[00:48:07] evict: session sid=cd34... duration=4100s
... (snip)
[00:50:12] evict: completed 112 sessions
```
seana: freed 3 GPUs, reserved_utilization=94% now, queue_depth=612. latency improving but still high.
priya: NimbusCorp confirms reduced timeouts but some API calls still above SLO. support routed safe-fallback to cached endpoints where possible.
jamal: we still see sustained high session creation from nv-93 — probably a customer-side traffic spike that will persist. need long-term mitigation: either raise pool scale_limit or split tenant to dedicated reservation.
marta: raised a temporary scale_limit to 16 for dedicated-resv-eu-west (immediate change), autoscaler accepted new cap.
ops-bot: autoscaler: scale_event triggered -> provisioning 4 nodes, estimated ready=~8m
seana: provisioning started. notify billing/partner ops for potential overage with reserved pools.
priya: notified account exec. NimbusCorp asked for ETA on steady state. told them ~10-15m.
jamal: monitoring: new nodes coming up, 3/4 ready, reserved_utilization=78% now, queue_depth=220.
seana: good. also adding a short-term routing rule: route nv-93 less-latency-sensitive traffic to best-effort pool to reduce reserved pressure. Marta, annotate routing rule id=rb-3580.
marta: routing rule applied -> affected_sessions_replaced=~180, queue_depth=120.
seana: confirming customer impact: NimbusCorp partial degradation acknowledged, no data loss, majority of requests succeeded with higher latency for 22m window.
priya: support to send customer post-incident note: include timeline, actions taken, and recommended next steps (partitioning, reservation increase).
jamal: action items during incident:
- rollback eviction if we see >0.5% increased 5xxs (jamal)
- monitor autoscaler health for 24h (marta)
- create tenant isolation proposal for nv-93 (seana & eng-runtime)
- billing/ops follow-up re: temporary capacity (priyaa)
seana: tagging eng-runtime on this thread for postmortem and follow-up: @eng-runtime please review scale limit behavior and improve pre-warn for sustained queue growth.
oncall-pager: handing back to oncall rotation; seana remains incident lead for follow-up.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: pool stabilized, final_utilization=63%, queue_depth=42, duration=01:07:00 :white_check_mark:
seana: quick recap for postmortem: root cause = sudden tenant traffic spike + per-pool hard scale_limit + noisy long-running sessions. mitigations = targeted eviction, temp scale_limit increase, traffic routing.
jamal: I'll prep a short timeline + logs for postmortem. seana, marta — can you add exact command outputs to the incident doc?
seana: yes. will add eviction logs and autoscaler events.
priya: I'll draft the customer communication and share.
marta: scheduling follow-up meeting with eng-runtime and account team for tomorrow 09:30 UTC.
seana: thanks all. closing thread once notes are posted. :thumbsup:
